description:
**Job Title: Technical Support Executive (Software Support)**
Job Summary: We are looking for a Technical Support Executive to provide software-related support to customers. The role involves attending customer calls, troubleshooting software issues, providing remote assistance, and ensuring timely resolution of customer queries.
  
  
Location: #24 Shambavi Building 23rd Main Marenahalli JP Nagar 2nd Phase Bengaluru - 560078
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Attend customer calls and provide technical support. Troubleshoot software-related issues. Assist with software installation and configuration. Provide remote support to customers. Escalate unresolved issues to the technical team. Maintain support tickets and customer records.
  
  
**Qualification**
Any Graduate / BCA / B.E. / B.Tech
  
  
**Experience**
Freshers or 0–1 years of experience.
  
  
Languages: Hindi & English
